author: reek
body: The route layer. A pure function from state, caller identity, day, and request to new state and response, so the whole service is testable by constructing HttpRequest records directly -- no sockets required. Every response body is a JsonValue tree emitted by the Json foreword.

author: reek
body: The reservation protocol: GET /offer deals three candidate ideas drawn from unreserved seeds, at most one offer per caller per day. GET /claim picks one of the three; the house reserves it for that caller alone and the other two return to the deck, so customers never compete on the same idea. GET /claims is the public ledger. GET /idea remains as unlimited window shopping: it never reserves and never counts against the daily deal.
